researchQuestion: In healthy adults, how does resistance-training frequency affect muscle hypertrophy when weekly training volume is matched?
protocolDetails: Population: healthy adults. Intervention/comparator: different weekly resistance-training frequencies with approximately matched weekly volume. Primary outcome: validated change in muscle size. Record training status, programme duration, adherence, adverse events, funding, conflicts and risk-of-bias information. Exclude animal, in-vitro and non-resistance-training studies.

searches.query: resistance training frequency muscle hypertrophy volume equated adults
resistance training frequency hypertrophy volume equated

criteria.name: Human comparative intervention
criteria.instructions: Include comparative resistance-training interventions in human adults that report a direct muscle-size outcome.

criteria.name: Frequency comparison
criteria.instructions: Include only studies comparing at least two weekly training frequencies.

criteria.name: Volume comparability
criteria.instructions: Include studies that match or explicitly report weekly training volume across groups.

questions.name: Population
questions.instructions: Extract sample size, age, sex distribution and resistance-training status by arm.

questions.name: Intervention
questions.instructions: Extract weekly frequency, weekly sets, intensity, exercise selection and programme duration by arm.

questions.name: Hypertrophy outcome
questions.instructions: Extract measurement method, anatomical site, change by arm, between-group effect estimate and confidence interval.

questions.name: Harms and adherence
questions.instructions: Extract adverse events, attrition and adherence by arm.

questions.name: Bias and conflicts
questions.instructions: Extract randomisation, allocation concealment, blinding where applicable, missing-data handling, funding and conflicts.
